name: barbell seated bradford rocky press
description: A seated press in which the bar moves between the front of the shoulders and just above the head, never fully locking out.
instructions: Sit upright on a bench with your feet flat and the bar at the front of your shoulders.
Press just high enough for the bar to clear your head, without fully locking out your elbows.
Move your head gently forward and lower the bar behind your head to a comfortable depth.
Press the bar back just above your head and lower it to the front of your shoulders to complete one cycle.
Keep the movement controlled and use a light load.
